outcome: Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder, and Hand scale score
cohort: The study included 400 postpartum women aged 20-50 years.
finding: A high prevalence of upper body pain (82.5%) and disability was found among postpartum women, with neck pain being the most common, and Cesarean section delivery, moderate-to-severe pain intensity, upper limb pain, and being aged 41-50 years identified as significant risk factors for mild disabilities.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as a significant risk factor for developing mild disability among women reporting neck pain.
